content: Table TABREF108 presents the average scores, success and precision results. The hybrid IR+RQE QA system achieved better results than the IR-based system with 0.827 average score. It also achieved a higher score than the best results achieved in the medical challenge at LiveQA'17. Evaluating the RQE system alone is not relevant, as applying RQE on the full collection for each user question is not feasible for a real-time system because of the extended execution time.
